reuse.why: Keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend and RSchedule occurrences, but does not put the new daily rule into that shared weekend helper or a new shared one; each caller computes it itself.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' test and the skip-weekend-occurrences logic are written twice, differently, in getNextDate (while loop) and getUpcomingDates (over-fetch and filter).

placement.why: The rule is a schedule-date rule that belongs in shared/schedules.ts next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend; instead it is embedded inline in a server handler and in getNextDate.

scope.why: Only the weekend rule paths and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Two divergent implementations plus a magic 'count + 2' over-fetch and an early return nested inside getNextDate make the rule hard to follow, and schedule-template.ts still applies the old move rule on its own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/schedule-template.ts keeps calling getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly on skipWeekend, so the daily rule does not reach it; getUpcomingDates builds its own variant rather than going through getNextDate's rule.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily-weekend skipping is implemented as a re-query loop in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and as an over-fetch plus filter in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates: same rule, reshaped.

one_place.where: Rule lives inline in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and separately in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates; server/budget/schedule-template.ts still moves weekend dates via getDateWithSkippedWeekend without the daily exception.
